messages.subject: shinyapps.io at 'getting started' stage, despite functional account
parts:
Hi, 

Every time I visit shinyapp.io, I keep getting the 'getting started' info. However, I have gone through the three steps successfully and have no trouble deploying apps. If I log out and back in again, everything's OK, but I would like to skip that and automatically see what I should see whenever going to the bookmarked home page. I'm logging in with my Google login and am in the Starter Plan.

What should I do?


g's,

Jeroen.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyapps.io at 'getting started' stage, despite functional account
parts:
That's strange. Deploying your first application should prevent the getting started page from appearing. By chance do you have more than one account? You can tell if you click the account drop down next to your user icon in the dashboard. If more than one account is listed, that might explain why the getting started dialog is appearing. 

-Andy
